known_risks: the teacher prompt was chosen on development labels that also fit the combiner
the six worked examples come from the id crosswalk and inherit its noise (one is a likely HFR duplicate labelled different)
the test truth is the id crosswalk; a match to an HFR duplicate counts as wrong
the combiner was fitted on about 1,700 labelled pairs from the seven test states, the same for every arm
question: Does distilling a local Qwen2.5-7B teacher into the cross-encoder let the decider settle more of the engine's held pairs without more wrong matches?

arms.hard: X8's training examples plus the engine's held pairs in the training states that have an id label (hard labels only)
arms.student: X8's training examples plus every engine held pair in the training states; targets 0.5*hard + 0.5*teacher where a hard label exists, teacher alone otherwise; close negatives and far positives blended the same way

rule.cross_encoder: X0 recipe (e5-small, 1 epoch, lr 3e-5, batch 32), seeds 0-2, the same states held out as X8 (Edo, Kano, Ondo, Lagos, FCT, Oyo, Anambra)
rule.decider: for every arm and seed: X8's augmented combiner fitted on the 1,707 development labels; located thresholds
rule.fallback: if student_pass is false, the owner asked to try synthetic name variants next (option 2), then active learning (option 3)
rule.hard_subsets: training states only: negatives with name trigram cosine >= 0.85, positives with cosine < 0.5, and the engine's held pairs (hard label from the id crosswalk where the facility has a twin in the state)

metrics.auc_cross_encoder: AUC of the cross-encoder logit on scorable pairs
metrics.twins_matched: scorable pairs auto-matched that are twins
metrics.wrong_matched: scorable pairs auto-matched that are not twins

rule.pass: student_pass: mean over seeds of twins_matched >= 1.05 x the baseline mean, and mean wrong_matched <= the baseline mean
rule.secondary: teacher_helps: student mean twins_matched >= hard mean and student mean wrong_matched <= hard mean; AUCs; held counts
rule.teacher: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, 4-bit nf4 (bitsandbytes), local; score P(Yes)/(P(Yes)+P(No)) from next-token logits; prompt in x9_teacher.py with the six worked examples in data/er_bench/x9_teacher_fewshot.json (drawn at random, seed 0, from the training-state hard subsets)
rule.teacher_selection: two prompts tried on the 1,707 development labels: zero-shot AUC 0.849 (below the student's 0.902), six-shot AUC 0.909; the six-shot prompt is used. The test was not consulted
rule.test: the engine's held (review) pairs in the seven held-out states (national run), against the id crosswalk: label 1 if the HFR record is the GRID3 facility's twin, 0 if the facility has a twin in the state and this is another record, unscorable otherwise. The teacher never saw these pairs
